:::{.card title="Lemma 5.1"}
$$
\begin{align*}
& C_n^i = \min \{ k \geq C_n^{i - 1}: |A^x(a_n) \cap D^y(k)| = i\} \\
& A = A_{a_n}^{x, t} \\
& U = [n_t] \setminus \left( D_{a_n}^{x, t} \, \cup \, A_{a_n}^{x, t} \right) = \{v \in [n_t]: v \text{ never touched in SWT}^x \}  \\
& A^{y,t}(k) \subset A_{a_n}^{x, t} \, \cup \, \{v \in [n_t]: v \text{ never touched in SWT}^x \} \\
& A^{y,t}(k) 
  = \{v \in A_{a_n}^{x, t}: v \text{ touched in SWT}^y \text{ by time }k \} \, 
\cup \, \{v \in [n_t]: v \text{ never touched in SWT}^x \text{ but touched in SWT}^y \text{ by time }k \} \\
& \phantom{A^{y,t}(k)} = L_A(k) \cup L_U(k) \\
& L_A = A^{y,t}(k) \cap A_{a_n}^{x, t} \\
& \text{Since we are frozen at time }a_n \text{, all collisions edges we find remain alive in SWT}^x 
  \text{ as well as in SWT}^y \text{ until SWT}^x \text{ is unfrozen}. \\
& \text{Each time a vertex splits in } \Psi_{\kappa}^y \text{, the label of its type } t \text{ children are picked uniformly at random without replacement amongst } \\
& \text{the possible labels } [n_t] \setminus D_{a_n}^{x, t} \\
& \text{Clearly } A \cup U = [n_t] \setminus D_{a_n}^{x, t} \\
& \text{Memorylessness and independence of the exponential waiting times } \implies \\
& \quad \mathrm{P} \left( v_{ \text{split} }^k = v \, | \, \text{type } t \text{ particle dies at step } k \right) 
= \frac{1}{|L_A^t(k) \cup L_U^t(k)|}, \forall v \in |L_A^t(k) \cup L_U^t(k)|. \\
\end{align*}
$$ 





$$
\begin{align*}
\mathrm{P} \left( v_{ \text{split} }^k = v \, | \, v \in L_A(k) \right)
& = \mathrm{P} \left( v_{ \text{split} }^k = v , v \in L_A(k) \, | \, v \in L_A(k)\right) \\
& =  \frac{
  \mathrm{P} \left( v \in L_A(k) \, | \, v_{ \text{split} }^k = v , v \in L_A(k) \right) 
  \mathrm{P} \left( v_{ \text{split} }^k = v \right) 
  }
  {\mathrm{P} \left( v \in L_A(k) \right)} \\
& = \frac{1 \cdot \frac{1}{ |L_U(k) \cup L_A(k)|} }{ \frac{|L_A(k)|}{|L_U(k) \cup L_A(k)| } } \\
& = \frac{1}{|L_A(k)|} \\
\end{align*}
$$


$$
\begin{align*}
M_n \, \& \, N_n \text{ independent } + M_n \xrightarrow{d} M + N_n \xrightarrow{d} N 
& \implies (M_n, N_n) \xrightarrow{d} (M, N) \\
& \implies M_n + N_n \xrightarrow{d} M + N 
\end{align*}
$$
